muyesser-irab:85-85.t: ﴿ووقع القول عليهم بما ظلموا فهم لا ينطقون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿وقع القول﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿وقع﴾; ﴿بما ظلموا﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿وقع﴾, i.e.: "because of their wrongdoing", and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (infinitival); the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿لا ينطقون﴾ is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:86-86.t: ﴿ألم يروا أنا جعلنا الليل ليسكنوا فيه والنهار مبصرا إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يؤمنون﴾: the hamza is for interrogation of affirmation (taqrīr) and of disapproval (inkār); لم is a particle of negation, conversion [to the past] and the jussive; يروا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, and the seeing here is mental, not visual; أن and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of يروا; أن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun (ism), and the clause ﴿جعلنا﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿الليل﴾ is the object of جعلنا, and the second object of جعل is omitted, its implied form being "dark" (مظلما); the lām is for causation (taʿlīl); يسكنوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) أن after the lām of causation, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from أن and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جعلنا﴾; ﴿فيه﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يسكنوا﴾. ﴿والنهار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and النهار is the first object of an omitted verb indicated by the one mentioned, its implied form being "We made" (جعلنا); ﴿مبصرًا﴾ is the second object of the omitted verb; إن is an abrogating particle; ﴿في ذلك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted, fronted khabar of إن; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); آيات is its postponed noun; ﴿لقوم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective); and the clause يؤمنون is a ṣifa of ﴿قوم﴾.

muyesser-irab:87-87.t:
﴿ويوم ينفخ في الصور ففزع من في السماوات ومن في الأرض﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿يوم﴾ is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding ﴿يوم﴾ in the saying of the Exalted ﴿ويوم نحشر﴾; the clause ﴿ينفخ﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هو); ﴿في الصور﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينفخ﴾; ﴿ففزع﴾ is conjoined (ʿaṭf) to ﴿ينفخ﴾; ﴿مَن﴾ is the fāʿil (agent) of فزع; ﴿في السماوات﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause), and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. ﴿ومن في الأرض﴾ is conjoined to ﴿من في السماوات﴾.
﴿إلا من شاء الله وكل أتوه داخرين﴾: إلا is a particle of exception, and ﴿من﴾ is the excepted (mustathnā); the clause ﴿شاء الله﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿وكل﴾: the wāw is circumstantial, or a conjunction; ﴿كل﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause ﴿أتوه﴾ is the khabar (predicate), and ﴿داخرين﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:88-88.t:
﴿وترى الجبال تحسبها جامدة وهي تمر مر السحاب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ترى الجبال﴾ is a nominative (marfūʿ) imperfect verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), its implied form being "you" (أنت), and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿تحسبها﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الجبال; ﴿ها﴾ is the first object of تحسبها, and ﴿جامدة﴾ is the second object of تحسبها. ﴿وهي﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); ﴿هي﴾ is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿تمر﴾ is the khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl from the latent pronoun in ﴿جامدة﴾; ﴿مر﴾ is an accusative mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and ﴿السحاب﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿صنع الله الذي أتقن كل شيء إنه خبير بما تفعلون﴾: ﴿صُنْعَ﴾ is the mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb, emphasising the content of the clause before it; the implied form is: "Allah made that, a making" (صنع الله ذلك صنعا); the maṣdar (verbal noun) is annexed to its fāʿil. ﴿الذي﴾ is in the position of a genitive as a ṣifa (adjective) of the Name of Majesty (﴿لفظ الجلالة﴾). The clause ﴿أتقن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿كل شيء﴾ is the object of أتقن. إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun (ism); خبير is its khabar. ﴿بما﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خبير﴾. The clause ﴿تفعلون﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:89-89.t: ﴿من جاء بالحسنة فله خير منها وهم من فزع يومئذ آمنون﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ﴿مَن﴾ is a conditional noun putting the verb in the jussive (jāzim), mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿بالحسنة﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاء﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of جاء, in which case the bāʾ is for accompaniment (mulābasa), i.e.: "he came bearing it"; the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate), and ﴿خير﴾ is the postponed mubtadaʾ; ﴿منها﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of ﴿خير﴾, or attached to ﴿خير﴾ on the view that it is an elative (ism tafḍīl); ﴿هم﴾ is a mubtadaʾ; من فزع is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿آمنون﴾; ﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم: an adverb of time attached to an omitted ṣifa of ﴿فزع﴾, i.e.: "a terror occurring on that day"; إذٍ: a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied sukūn, because the place [of the vowel] is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause, i.e.: "on the day when he brings the good deed", or "on the day when the Horn is blown". ﴿آمنون﴾ is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿هم﴾.

muyesser-irab:90-90.t: ﴿ومن جاء بالسيئة فكبت وجوههم في النار هل تجزون إلا ما كنتم تعملون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; مَن is conditional; ﴿جاء بالسيئة﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa), entering upon an omitted ﴿قد﴾, i.e.: "قد كبت", so that it is valid for the apodosis to be joined with it; كبت is a past verb whose agent is not named (passive), and ﴿وجوههم﴾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿في النار﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كبت﴾; the clause ﴿فكبت﴾ is in the position of a jussive (jazm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿هل﴾ is an interrogative particle; تجزون is a passive imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: "their faces will be cast down, it being said to them: Are you recompensed…"; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); ﴿ما﴾ is the second object of ﴿تجزون﴾; the clause كنتم is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, the tāʾ is its noun (ism), and the clause تعملون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:91-91.t:
﴿إنما أمرت أن أعبد رب هذه البلدة الذي حرمها﴾: the clause is the object of an omitted saying (maqūl qawl maḥdhūf), i.e.: "Say to them: I have only been commanded"; إنما is [إن] made inoperative (kāffa wa-makfūfa) [Translator's note: i.e. إنّ followed by the restraining ما]; أمرت is a past verb whose agent is not named (passive), and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿أن أعبد﴾ is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) that is accusative by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أمرت﴾; رب is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and ﴿هذه﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); البلدة: a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative; الذي: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿رب هذه البلدة﴾; the clause حرمها: the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.
﴿وله كل شيء وأمرت أن أكون من المسلمين﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (lil-ḥāl); ﴿له﴾: a fronted khabar (predicate); كل: the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); شيء: muḍāf ilayhi; أمرت: a passive past verb, and the tāʾ is the nāʾib fāʿil; أن أكون: interpreted as a maṣdar that is accusative by removal of the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أمرت﴾; من المسلمين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of أكون.

muyesser-irab:92-92.t:
﴿وأن أتلو القرآن فمن اهتدى فإنما يهتدي لنفسه﴾: ﴿وأن أتلو﴾: conjoined (ʿaṭf) to أن أكون, i.e.: "and I have been commanded to recite"; القرآن: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); فمن: the fāʾ is for consequence (tafrīʿiyya), and مَن: conditional, mubtadaʾ (subject); اهتدى: a past verb in the position of a jussive (jazm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa); إنما: [إن] made inoperative (kāffa wa-makfūfa); يهتدي: an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); لنفسه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يهتدي﴾; and the condition-and-apodosis clause is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿ومن ضل فقل إنما أنا من المنذرين﴾: conjoined to the one before it; مَن: conditional, mubtadaʾ; ضل: a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis; the fāʾ is linking; قل: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "you" (أنت); إنما: made inoperative; أنا: mubtadaʾ; من المنذرين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); and the condition-and-apodosis clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ.

muyesser-irab:93-93.t: ﴿وقل الحمد لله سيريكم آياته فتعرفونها وما ربك بغافل عما تعملون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قل: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); الحمد: mubtadaʾ (subject); ﴿لله﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); سيريكم: the sīn is a particle of the future, يريكم is an imperfect verb, and the kāf is the first object; آياته: the second object; the clause is part of the completion of the object of saying, strung on the same thread; فتعرفونها: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and تعرفونها is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā, which operates like laysa; ﴿ربك﴾ is the noun (ism) of ما; ﴿بغافل﴾: the bāʾ is an additive preposition (ṣila), and غافل is genitive in wording and accusative in position, as the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾; ﴿عما﴾: عن is a preposition, and ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun in the position of a genitive, i.e.: "about what you do"; or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿تعملون﴾ is genitive by ﴿عن﴾, i.e.: "about your doing"; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿غافل﴾; and the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
